name: B.O.B. Gear Revolution Flex 3.0 Jogging Stroller

clekListed.clekRow: B.O.B. Gear Revolution Flex 3.0 — Single Infant Car Seat Adapter (S12046000)

_priceNote: Target listing carries it; price often discounts below the $649.99 MSRP — reconfirm live. bobgear MSRP and bobparts both $649.99 at check.

specs._foldedNote: 38 x 25 x 16 in with wheels on; ~35 x 20 x 10 in with quick-release wheels removed (14,748 cu in). Some retailers cite 39 x 24.5 x 16 in.

brake.type: flip-flop-friendly foot-pedal parking brake (no hand brake)
brake.power: Wrist safety strap (runaway tether) included for jogging; parking-brake hold-force not published; no auto-lock feature stated.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: 8 mo+ in stroller seat for jogging/off-road; birth-ready with an infant car seat + adapter (S12046000)

safety.standards: Meets US ASTM F833 / 16 CFR 1227 carriage & stroller standard
safety.certifications: 5-point easy-adjust, no-rethread harness; UPF 50+ canopy; wrist tether. JPMA certification not published by BOB.
safety.notes: Basket weight limit not published (null). Adjustable-tracking front wheel for straight-line jogging.

recall.note: No recall found for the Revolution Flex 3.0. Earlier BOB single/double joggers made 1998–Sep 2015 (prior Revolution/Flex generations) were subject to a 2018 CPSC administrative complaint and 2019 settlement over front quick-release-wheel detachment (free thru-bolt axle remedy); the redesigned Flex 3.0 is a later model not covered.

specs.foldType: 2-step compact fold with quick-release removable wheels
specs.tires: pneumatic (air-filled) all-terrain; 12 in front swivel (lockable) + adjustable tracking, 16 in rear; mountain-bike-style suspension

notes: Full-size all-terrain single jogger, 28.5 lb. Clek Liing attaches via BOB Single Infant Car Seat Adapter S12046000 (adapter-s12046000). Like the Alterrain family, this is a rugged/heavy stroller — the opposite end of the spectrum from the light city/shopping goal, but on Clek's list and fully sourced.
